text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Sky-san! Happy birthday! I actually have a 
present for you...!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yay, thank you! Wonder what it is... Maybe 
I should try guessing~

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, how about a 10-carat diamond or 
something after all? Or maybe a lakeside 
villa!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? U-Umm... I'm so sorry! Actually... 
it's a pressed flower bookmark.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Sky-san wears floral hair accessories, and 
she was so happy when I made a flower 
crown before, so I thought maybe she 
really liked flowers...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ah—... the daisy crown, right~? Yep yep, I 
remember!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
When you smiled and thanked me back then, 
I was so happy, and it made me feel all 
warm inside, just like sunshine.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Seeing you smile like that made me think 
you really love flowers, and it made me so 
very happy.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...No, you're right. I do like flowers. 
You win, I give up.
